items.question: What tenfold purification must be performed after chanting the self-born flower for the beloved?
premises: The self-born flower is the object purified.
items.inference: The practitioner chants, then purifies the self-born flower tenfold for the beloved.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic role of priya is unclear; it may be vocative or adjectival.
The precise ritual context of the tenfold purification is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Having chanted, let him purify the self-born flower tenfold, O beloved.
